_comment: Ground truth from Factorio 2.1.23 (build 87750, linux64, headless), read with calculate_tile_properties on game.planets["gleba"].create_surface() with map_gen_settings.seed FORCED to 123456 (map seed 123456). One batch, in the order of `positions` (1/256 grid). Each field is the hex of its f32, one per position. `tiles` are the tile scores, keyed by tile name: read as 'tile:<name>:probability' and as a data-stage var('tile:<name>:probability') expression, bit-identical wherever both answered. Cross-checked: 2.0.77 (build 84539, linux64, headless) returned bit-identical values. The same probe, run in malte9799/FactorioTools' convention (map seed 123, derived seed), agrees bit for bit with their e1ac68ee750488d7b8b03574e5747f81c672fce0 packages/mapgen/test/fixtures/gleba-123.json at their 100 positions on 2.0.77 (44 fields); their file has no column for t_tile_lowland_red_infection. Positions: the first 4 positions of a 16384-position scout pool where each tile wins the strict argmax, filled up in pool order. Captured by scripts/probes/planet-fields.
